name: One Dark

provenance.bg.inset: choice: no tone below background (ANSI black = background)
provenance.bg.stripe: derived: bg.base darkened to 1.07:1 (weakest fill; bg.inset is invisible here, 1.00:1 vs inactive selection 1.44:1) - zebra rules in layout-archetypes §2.4
provenance.fg.muted: choice: no grey between comment_grey (2.32:1) and foreground; derived: foreground @alpha over background (Textual $foreground-muted convention), alpha raised until >= 4.5:1 [blend(foreground, background, 0.8)]
provenance.fg.on-accent: spec: DiffAdd/DiffDelete/Search draw black on the accent
provenance.accent.primary: spec: Function/Directory = blue; PmenuSel fill = blue
provenance.selection.bg: spec: PmenuSel = cursor_grey on blue (accent-fill selection)
provenance.selection.inactive.bg: choice: neutral Visual tone when the pane loses focus

notes: Discrepancy (cursor): kitty/alacritty #5c6370 vs term/One Dark.Xresources (README: canonical) #abb2bf. Used #abb2bf: canonical, and #5c6370 is only 2.32:1 on the background.
Discrepancy (selection): kitty selection #5c6370 with fg #2c323c (2.1:1) vs alacritty #3e4452 with cell foreground. Used alacritty's #3e4452 (= onedark.vim Visual) and null foreground.
ANSI quirks: 0 = cursor_grey #2c323c (not the background), 7 = comment_grey (dim), 8 = visual_grey #3e4452 (1.44:1), brights 9-14 = normals.

ansi16 overrides (hue-aware nearest slot that clears the contract floor; dim modelled as 55% blend): diff.changed -> '3' (slot 4 #61afef is not the #e5c07b hue; slot 3 = #e5c07b, 8.10:1) | fg.muted -> '15' (default 'default dim' resolves to 3.06:1; now 6.57:1) | fg.faint -> 'default dim' (default '8' resolves to 1.44:1; now 3.06:1) | border.default -> '7 dim' (default '8' resolves to 1.44:1; now 1.58:1)
